introConfigurazione: To open enrolment you need the two fees and at least one form for each list. Places are a guide: exceeding them never blocks an enrolment.
dopoApertura: Enrolment is already open: fees, forms and places can still be corrected, and families see the changes straight away. A fee already created for a child keeps its amount: changing the price list now applies to new fees.
erroreRete: Could not reach the server. Try again shortly.
errorePermesso: You cannot change this data for this location.
erroreLettura: Could not read the data. Try again shortly.
importoNonValido: Enter an amount greater than zero, for example 120 or 120.50.
moduloTitoloVuoto: Enter the form title (at most 120 characters).
postiNonValidi: Enter the number of places, digits only (zero included).
scadenzaNota: Without a date, the fee is due thirty days after it is created.
quotaConfermaNota: Paid by those who stay at the same school. You can set one amount for all age groups or one for each.
quotaNuovaNota: Paid by those enrolling for the first time. You can set one amount for all age groups or one for each.
moduloToglierePerde: Removing a form also removes the ticks families have already made.
postiIntro: Authorised places per age group. They warn when an age group is full: they never remove the offer or block an enrolment.
classiNotaPreparazione: The current year’s classes are copied automatically when you open enrolment. If you add a new one beforehand, you can copy it from here too: those already copied are not duplicated.
classiNotaAperte: If you added a class to the current year, you can copy it here: those already copied are not duplicated. Teachers, timetables and subjects are never copied.
classiFasciaIntro: Each class has a group (nursery, pre-school, primary…): it is used by the fees per group and by the places. The classes of the current year do not change.
classiElencoVuoto: There are no classes for this year yet: press “Copy the classes of the current year”.
classiSenzaFascia: Classes without a group: {n}. Until a class has a group, the fees per group do not apply to its children and the places do not count them.
retteNota: What each child pays per month. A row for a group applies to the classes of that group; “All groups” applies to everyone else. A child with their own tuition in their profile keeps it.
retteNessuna: There is no tuition for this year yet: until you set one (the “All groups” row), children without tuition in their profile do not receive the charge. Type the amount below and press Save.
retteAnnoInCorso: This is the current year. The new tuition applies to the charges generated from now on: charges already created do not change.
retteSolaLettura: This year is closing or closed: tuition can only be read. Charges already created do not change.
retteTolta: Tuition removed ✓ Without an “All groups” tuition, children with no tuition of their own no longer receive the charge.
retteSenzaFasce: The classes do not have a group yet: the tuition without a group (“All groups”) applies. The rows per group start working when the classes have theirs.
retteCopiata: Amount copied from the previous price list: please check it.
retteMesiTitolo: Months in which tuition is generated
retteMesiNota: Applies to the “All groups” row. Usually September to June. Tuition already created does not change.
